product.title: Catamaran Sailing Cruise in Monterey

description.text: Sail Monterey Bay on a catamaran cruise from the harbor with wind-powered navigation and complimentary beverages on board. Watch for sea otters, harbor seals, dolphins, and seasonal whales while your captain handles the sails across the Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary.

highlights: Catamaran sailing cruise on Monterey Bay
Wildlife viewing for sea otters, seals, dolphins, and whales
Spacious deck on Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary waters

start.description: Arrive at the Monterey harbor meeting point at least 45 minutes before departure to allow time for parking and boarding.

itineraryItems.title: Monterey Harbor
itineraryItems.description: Board the catamaran and depart the harbor toward open bay waters.

itineraryItems.title: Monterey Bay
itineraryItems.description: Sail the sanctuary with the captain trimming sails while guests watch for marine wildlife.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
